posts.text: Happy International Women’s Day! I’m extremely proud to announce that last weekend, my team of Sarina Cheng, Vivian Song, Helia Bahasadri, and I won 1st overall at ProdX (Western’s only product case competition)! We were tasked with developing a solution for Duolingo that addressed the proficiency plateau — when long-term users feel minimal improvement in functional fluency, despite using the app everyday. Last weekend, I had the chance to attend Friends of Figma, Toronto's Summer Picnic. I was nervous going in — it was my first FoF event and I didn’t know anyone there. But I reminded myself that sometimes, you just have to do it afraid. As someone at the start of their design journey, I loved getting to chat with experienced designers and hear about their paths, challenges, and tips. Last weekend, I had the opportunity to compete in Western Founders Network's Product Design Sprint. I’m extremely proud to announce that my team, Vivian Song, Chloe Zou, and Anthony Ung, won first place! The prompt for this year discussed redesigning social and digital environments to build meaningful connections.
